source_provenance.sql:
SELECT lmfdb_label, conductor, array_to_json(ainvs)::text AS ainvs_json, analytic_rank
FROM ec_curvedata
WHERE NOT (lmfdb_label = ANY(%s))
ORDER BY conductor, lmfdb_label COLLATE "C"
LIMIT %s
